datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Haiti to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classification zones and scenarios were compiled for each month of 2022 and distributed as GeoJSON and KML files with classification metadata including period dates, scenarios, and assistance eligibility indicators.
